description: Track how a company's earnings-call themes move quarter over quarter: a theme by fiscal-quarter table of mention counts and tone across its last scored calls, oldest first, with each theme's status on the latest call (new, recurring, dropped, or unknown where an unscored quarter sits between the calls compared). Themes are paired across calls by name or shared keywords. Verifier-approved reads only; GetEarningsCallToneAndThemes gives one call's scores and keywords.

calls.description: Number of most recent scored fiscal quarters to compare (default 8, max 12; values outside 1-12 are clamped)

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetEarningsCallThemeHistory
title: Earnings Call Theme History
